items.source_en: Sulfanilamide bonds with carbon chains in the animal's digestive tract to create a unique compound. We have no means to replicate this process so we must use the compound derived from our organic source. It will be extracted and purified through the process of recrystallization. Recrystallization is the most common method for purifying solids. The concept is to use a solvent in which the desired product will readily dissolve when heated, yet is also insoluble at room temperature, allowing the recrystallization. By isolating our compound, we hope to prove our expected potential of this compound and its applications as fertilizer for local flora. PLEASE FOLLOW THE STEPS IN THE PROCEDURE. It is paramount we adhere to the schedule.
